utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping off tools and spare parts—really nice turnout so far.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s good to see people helping out. I’m just hoping we get enough to keep everything running.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think we will—people around here always come through when it matters. I’ll swing by later and see if anyone’s brought in anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it’s still on for today. I’ll swing by around the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just wanted to make sure. See you around the usual time then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you helping get the word out. I’m still hearing things second-hand, so I’ll be glad when folks know the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep repeating the time to everyone I see so nobody misses it. If you hear a neighbor who’s unsure, send them my way and I’ll tell them too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I think I saw the notice, but I might’ve missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the notice and tell you where the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help a lot. I was a bit scattered this week and didn’t catch where it’s at.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what’s the first repair you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let’s start with the leaky faucet in the hall—it's quick, and it’ll make a big difference.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good call—I’ll grab the wrench and check the washer first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s coming together nicely—people seem ready to pitch in. I can swing by later and drop off anything you still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Ira—thank you. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up before then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course—just send me a note if you need anything else before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Rey — could you help by checking in with neighbors and jotting down any repair needs? I’ll keep the list organized and we can compare notes later.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll check in with the neighbors and write down any repair needs I hear. I’ll bring my notes back so we can compare.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive and jot down anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll swing by a bit late, but I can help once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem — I’ll start sorting the supplies now and save a few tasks for you when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after drop-off and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a huge help—thanks, Faye. I’ll set the tools out and be ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll head over right after drop-off. If you need anything else before then, just text me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing this repair drive — it feels good to pull everyone together and help out. Want me to check in with the other groups and see what they can bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, please check with them—just let me know what’s actually coming so we don’t end up short.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll get clear confirmations and only pass along what’s definite. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs doing first, and when should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let’s start by sorting the donations and checking what parts we still need, then we can assign pickup and repair jobs. I can meet tomorrow after school around 3:30 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Let’s meet tomorrow at 3:30 and start with the donations and parts list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I'm glad it's happening. I should probably check what I can help with, if I don’t forget again.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I know, the list’s getting long—if you can, maybe just check the supply box and the sign-up sheet today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, I can do that today. I’ll check the supply box and the sign-up sheet before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, we’re doing the repair drive soon — want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, put me down. I can help out with whatever needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, I’ve got you down — thank you! I’ll send the details soon so you know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and how we’ll get everything there safely.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I hear you — let’s keep it simple and safe, and I’ll repeat the plan so we both stay on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot — if you can map out the timing and transport, I’ll feel much better about it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting a lot of support already—did I miss any big updates?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just that it’s picking up fast — lots of folks have chipped in already. I haven’t heard anything major beyond that.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Nice, that’s good to hear. I’m still catching up, so if you hear anything else big, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Sam — I’m pulling together the repair drive list now, and I’d love to hear what needs attention first on your end.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rosa — thanks for doing that. My front porch step is loose, and the kitchen faucet has a slow drip, so either one would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’ve got your porch step and kitchen faucet on the list, and I’ll see what we can line up first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you check what tools and supplies we still need, and whether anyone’s already signed up to help?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure—I’ll check the tools and supplies list first, then see who’s already signed up to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — could you help sort the donations table and keep an eye on the tool sign-out sheet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll sort the donations table and keep an eye on the tool sign-out sheet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I’m not sure what you mean by the repair drive yet. Could you tell me what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s the community repair drive for broken bikes and small appliances—could you help fix what’s still usable?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can help with that. If you show me what’s still usable, I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. It’s going steady — I’ve got the list here, and we’re right on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great to hear — I can help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you bring a screwdriver set and a flashlight? If you have them, a small wrench would help too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a screwdriver set, a flashlight, and a small wrench if I’ve got one. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Oren, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—yes, I think so! I’ll check my notes and make sure I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—can you let me know by Friday? I’m trying to confirm the volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that—where exactly is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great—it's at the community center parking lot on Maple after 3. I'll send you the exact spot if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps—I’ll head to the community center parking lot on Maple after 3.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can use some extra tape, zip ties, and a few basic tools if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can grab tape and zip ties, and I’ll check for a few basic tools too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful—thank you, Sam. I’ll send you the details and a quick list of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out and be ready to jump in.
